<role>

</role>
<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is lack of access to current reserve figures and supplier payment data during report generation. The most similar story, 'Reporting navigation' (4137, similarity 0.089), is unstarted and only covers navigation, not data availability. 'Payment history improvements' (4130) is completed but addresses transaction history tracking, not reserve figures or report-generation data access. 'Supplier contact details' (4129) and 'Supplier address fields' (4136) cover contact/address data, not payment or reserve data in reports. No completed story or roadmap item solves the same problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
